entries.name: Paradigm tables, mixed
entries.doesNotDo: It does not carry into speech on its own. Producing a cell on demand in a table is a long way from producing it mid-sentence.

entries.name: Minimal pairs / HVPT
entries.doesNotDo: Hearing a contrast is not saying it. Perception training transfers to production only partly, and it trains sounds rather than words.

entries.name: Cloze sentences
entries.doesNotDo: The sentence around the gap does much of the work. A cloze you can solve from context alone measures the context, not the form.

entries.name: Sentence transformation — tense, negation, person
entries.trains: flexibility with forms you already meet
entries.doesNotDo: It supplies the sentence. You never have to decide what to say, only how to bend it.

entries.name: Working through your own error log
entries.trains: your own patterns rather than the average learner's
entries.doesNotDo: It only contains errors you were caught making. Everything you avoid saying never reaches the log.

entries.name: Rule explanation at the point of error
entries.trains: understanding, exactly when it is wanted
entries.doesNotDo: Understanding a rule is not being able to apply it. It removes confusion; it does not produce automaticity.
